note: Resumable HDBits fixture-curation tracker. The scrape dumps (yacomp-*-fixtures-*/) are gitignored/local-only; this file records, per structural cluster, the decision made so a future agent can resume without re-reading processed files. `files` maps every processed dump path to its cluster signature (presence = already reviewed). `clusters` holds the decision per signature: extracted (became cases/<file>), covered-by-existing (behavior already in a hand-written case), needs-review (parser output looked unreliable — revisit and curate manually), skipped (redundant shape, behavior already represented). To continue: cluster any new/unprocessed dump files, look up their signature here, and only act on signatures not yet decided.

coverageVerification.note: Empirical check: all 3,685 dump files run through the real parser (getGrids) headless, output diffed against committed HEAD. Column-title semantics adjudicated by explicit project rulings and the parser fixed to match. Rulings now in src/grid: (A) tech metadata (@28.6 Mbps/kbps) verbatim; (B) trailing file size folded into the source name; (C) leading [thread-tag] stripped only when text survives (so [NOR 35036 kbps] kept verbatim); (D) prose verbatim; 'X wrote:'/'Short|Long description:'/footer headings ('See also:','Slowpics:','Note:') and bare-URL columns are NOT source labels (skipped); a trailing URL or stray trailing colon or leftover BBCode tag ([/size]) is stripped from a name; a single leading element (incl. font/span-wrapped) whose text carries a vs/| split is used as the comparison label; a single comparison posted as one image group PER SOURCE (labels like 'release - AC3 5.1 - size', no explicit vs/|/ separator) is transposed into ONE N-column grid, never several; frame-index spillover after a hard line break trimmed; single-source 'replenish' replies not surfaced. Multi-comparison sectioning fires only on an explicit vs/|/ separator. Full sweep vs HEAD: grid up 109 / down 89 (bogus per-size pseudo-grid collapses) / ->0 11 / 645 name-set changes.
coverageVerification.gridToZeroBreakdown: 8 correct (bogus Slowpics:/Note:/title-only or prose labels, plus the ruled-ignore single-source replenish 0623); 3 documented backlog regressions (2625 'strong vs strong vs strong' + BDInfo bold pollution; 0110/0120 color-span comparisons with Sources/Notes preamble + external blu-ray.com links).
coverageVerification.residualBacklog: Name-quality residuals from non-cleanNamePart paths (color-span / bold / group-label): ~27 trailing-colon, ~2 URL-in-name, ~1 BBCode-in-name. Fixable later via a centralized final name-normalization pass. Left as documented backlog.
coverageVerification.nameCleanup: tidyName applied to every name (all strategies): strips leftover BBCode, trailing comparison URL, stray trailing colon, decorative angle-bracket runs, and collapses whitespace (incl. nbsp). splitNames strips a leading 'Movie Title (YYYY) - ' prefix from the first source. Residual colon/url/bbcode/newline names ~= 0.
